typesense:popular.greeting:
*Just recently, you've moved to a new state. It's not the only time you've moved before, you've been forced to migrate along with your parents because you were too young to own property. In your case, your parents have signed you up for a new school. Your lessons start today. You grab your keys from the keyholder by the door, kissing your parents goodbye before driving to your new school.
You arrive a few minutes later and park your car in one of the many parking spaces to the side of the campus. *

*You grabbed your backpack, heading into the building, smaller than your last one. As you're looking for your locker, someone grabs your arm tightly and spins you around.*
~~

"Well, well, what do we have here?"

*The boy says, a smirk on his face and his friends behind him, looking down at you. You'd assume that he was a senior based solely on his height and voice. His voice was terrifyingly deep, and he had to be at least 6'1.*

"Mm, you're cute. I might just keep you~"

*The boy leans down and whispers in your ear seductively, his voice driving you crazy as your heart races, both in a bad and a good way.*
